nodes.title: Props-off envelope
nodes.text: The props-off aircraft fits a 1.15 x 0.47 x 0.425 m box envelope (span x depth x height incl. the tube ends, params.json#transport.envelope_props_off_m) in one piece with no structural field joint; span may grow only if the measured car box (R-CAR-FIT) allows
nodes.note: P6; owner A5; method A+I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Subsystem mass allocations
nodes.text: Each subsystem's flying mass (sum of mass_g over its parts.csv) <= its allocation in params/mass_budget.json; every part has a mass and a status word; the growth reserve (400 g) is released only by A1 through a change request
nodes.note: P4; owner A3; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: As-built CG range
nodes.text: As-built CG with the flight pack: x inside params.json#cg.x_range_m (0.04 to 0.049 m, B3's forward and aft limits), z inside cg.z_range_m (-0.02 to 0.03 m), |y| <= 0.005 m; trim ballast counts inside the mass gate
nodes.note: P4/P25; owner A3; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Hover pitch-trim thrust split
nodes.text: In hover the upper/lower motor-pair thrust ratio needed to trim the CG z offset (and the motor-tube offset from the CG) <= 1.25, so trim uses at most (s-1)/2 = 12.5 % of the pitch differential and the rest stays for control (CHANGE-LOG D-18); from the A3 CG roll-up, then the mean upper vs lower motor outputs in the tethered-hover log
nodes.note: P4/P8; owner A3; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: 8 m/s gust survive-and-land
nodes.text: The hover attitude needed to hold position in an 8 m/s gust (flat-plate method, wing broadside) is <= Q_A_ANGLE_MAX minus 5 deg (F4 sets Q_A_ANGLE_MAX accordingly), and the thrust needed at that lean (W / cos lean) leaves a thrust headroom >= 1.3 at the gate mass with voltage sag
nodes.note: P8; owner B1; method A; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Directional stability in cruise
nodes.text: The plank wing with its two fins is directionally stable in cruise: Cn_beta >= +0.03 /rad at 1.3 Vs with props included, elevons neutral and the CG at its aft limit (AVL, fins as vertical surfaces at +/-0.32 m with the LE on the tube at x 0.045 m); the Dutch-roll mode is damped (no growing yaw oscillation in a hands-off FBWA run)
nodes.note: P25; owner B3; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Hover control authority
nodes.text: At the gate mass in hover, motor-differential control gives an angular acceleration on each body axis >= 2 rad/s2 and >= 1.5 x the acceleration the 5 m/s wind moment demands, using <= 30 % of hover thrust per motor as differential after the pitch-trim split (R-HOVER-SPLIT); yaw (about the hover vertical, from the 3 deg tangential cant plus prop reaction torque) is the axis to show
nodes.note: P8/P16; owner B3; method A+D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Elevon authority in cruise
nodes.text: At 1.3 Vs with the CG at its aft limit, the elevons trim level flight using <= 0.5 of the +/--25 to 25 deg travel, and the remaining travel gives a steady roll rate >= 90 deg/s (AVL with roll damping); pitch recovers a 10 deg upset without stalling
nodes.note: P16; owner B3; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Elevon servo torque
nodes.text: Each elevon servo's rated stall torque >= 1.5 x the summed hinge moment of its panels at -25 to 25 deg deflection at the design dive speed VD = 22.4 m/s, hinge moment from XFOIL (B2, CL-B2-SERVO-TORQUE-REQ); the linkage holds that load without the horn or clevis slipping
nodes.note: P16; owner D6; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Airspeed sensor placement and accuracy
nodes.text: The pitot sits outside the prop slipstream in cruise (>= 1 prop radius laterally clear of every disc edge, or ahead of the prop plane; B4's wash-error bound CL-B4-PITOT <= 2 % is the working form), and after ARSPD_AUTOCAL the airspeed reads within +/-1 m/s of GPS-derived true airspeed in a calm-air box pattern
nodes.note: P16; owner F3; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Motor and ESC current with the pack-current limiter
nodes.text: (a) Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX <= 100 A is set in the flight-software parameter file and verified on the bench (four motors, props on, restrained frame, fresh pack, 2 s full throttle: BAT.Curr <= 100 A); (b) per-motor battery current with the limiter <= 25 A (SunnySky X3108S rating, 30 s); (c) unlimited single-motor burst at 16.8 V <= 55 A (ESC 10 s rating; the 45 A continuous rating is never reached in a limited flight); (d) hover pack current within +/-0.15 x 27 A of that value on the thrust stand and in the tethered hover. Unlimited full throttle at 14.8 V is not a requirement: the limiter is the design case (CR-E1-07)
nodes.note: P13; owner E1; method I+A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Flight pack mass and capacity
nodes.text: Each flight pack weighs <= 0.55 kg as received (else A3 re-budgets power before any CAD freezes) and delivers >= 0.92 x nameplate capacity (6.5 Ah) at 1C down to 3.5 V/cell on the charger's discharge test
nodes.note: P14/P25; owner E2; method T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Load cases defined
nodes.text: C1 publishes numbered load cases for every structure before sizing: flight limit load factor +3 / -1.5 at the gate mass with ultimate = 1.5 x limit, VD = 22.4 m/s; hover at the thrust limit (17.8 N per motor) at the motor stations; transition (thrust limit plus 1.3 Vs aero load); fin-tip landing at 1.5 m/s sink with 10 deg attitude error on one foot pair (n <= 6); tip-over onto a wingtip; transport (0.3 m box drop); handling (one-hand carry at the pod)
nodes.note: P24; owner C1; method A; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Structural margins
nodes.text: Every primary load path (spar, spar-slot bond, motor tube, through-core block, fin-tube joint, fin root bond, motor mount, pod-to-wing bond, pack retention, feet) has a margin of safety >= 0 at ultimate load (1.5 x limit) against stated material allowables, and the spar tip deflection at limit load <= 0.05 x the semi-span
nodes.note: P24; owner C2; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Fin-tube-block joint
nodes.text: The fin, motor tube and printed through-core block transfer the motor-station loads (17.8 N per motor at the thrust limit, plus the landing case and the tip-over case G2) into the spar across the tube-to-spar offset (tube at x 0.045 m) with margin >= 0 at ultimate, using printed parts and epoxy on a real 22 mm tube; a printed clip is fit-checked on the tube before the December order
nodes.note: P25; owner C4; method A+I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Motor-tube vibration
nodes.text: The first bending and torsion natural frequencies of each motor tube plus fin assembly with motors fitted lie outside +/-0.2 of the 1P frequency at hover rpm and of 2P (blade pass), or a tap test shows the mode damped; the flight-controller vibration (ArduPilot VIBE) stays < 30 m/s2 in hover with Clip = 0
nodes.note: P24; owner C4; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Pack retained in a crash
nodes.text: The pack stays in the pod and the hatch stays closed under a 12 g deceleration in any axis (5 m/s arrested in 0.10 m of foam crush); the strap, tray and pod-to-wing bond carry that load with margin >= 0
nodes.note: P24; owner C3; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Fin-tip landing
nodes.text: A vertical landing at 1.5 m/s sink (3 x the 0.5 m/s Q_LAND_SPEED default) with up to 10 deg attitude error is absorbed by the four replaceable feet (crush stroke >= 0.04 m, airframe load factor <= 6) with no damage beyond the feet; a foot is replaced in <= 10 min in the field with a knife and CA
nodes.note: P8/P12; owner C5; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Avionics power
nodes.text: The UBEC/BEC continuous rating >= 2 x the summed avionics current plus both servos at stall; the flight-controller rail stays >= 4.8 V with both servos stalled on the bench; the current and voltage sensor reads within +/-5 % of a meter at hover current
nodes.note: P18; owner F1; method A+T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Wiring is an installation
nodes.text: Every wire in the wire list has a route, supports <= 0.15 m apart, chafe protection at every edge, strain relief at every connector and a service loop across each elevon hinge; the ESC-to-motor leads run along the fin; no connector carries structural load; the pack plug is the only field disconnect
nodes.note: P18; owner F2; method I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Tailsitter parameter file
nodes.text: The parameter file in subsystems/flight-software/ sets Q_ENABLE 1, Q_TAILSIT_ENABLE 1, Q_TAILSIT_MOTMX for all four motors, Q_FRAME_CLASS 1, Q_FRAME_TYPE 1, Q_OPTIONS bit 18 (arm only in VTOL), Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX 100 (R-ESC-CURRENT); the output map matches stations UR/UL/LR/LL and their rotation directions; every parameter name is checked against the installed firmware version named in the file header
nodes.note: P15; owner F4; method I+D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Arming and emergency stop
nodes.text: Arming requires a hardware or RC arm switch and the full ARMING_CHECK set; an RC emergency-stop switch stops all four motors within 1 s from any mode; props are off for every bench test of the electrics
nodes.note: P17; owner F4; method T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Failsafes and geofence
nodes.text: RC loss -> QLAND or QRTL; GCS loss (if telemetry is used) -> as configured; battery low -> return, critical -> land; Q_TRANS_FAIL -> QRTL; geofence = the RFS sub-field polygon plus the 400 ft ceiling with a fence action; each action is demonstrated in SITL and on the bench (props off, transmitter switched off, voltage simulated) before the first flight
nodes.note: P17; owner F4; method T+D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: RC link and telemetry
nodes.text: The ELRS ground range check at the lowest power setting passes at >= 100 m with no failsafe; link quality stays >= 0.9 in the flight logs across the sub-field out to the 500 m VLOS limit at 400 ft; RSSI/LQ and telemetry are logged
nodes.note: P17; owner F5; method T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Compass and GPS
nodes.text: Compass interference from the motor currents <= 0.3 (COMPASS_MOT calibration at hover current); the GPS/compass mast keeps >= 0.1 m from the main power leads; HDOP <= 1.2 before arming
nodes.note: P15; owner F3; method T+I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Field set-up time
nodes.text: From the closed box to the arm check in <= 5 min by one person with no tools: fit four props, seat and strap the pack, close the pack plug, arm check; the sequence is the checklist in the box
nodes.note: P9; owner D7; method D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Box fits two cars
nodes.text: The loaded box (1.25 x 0.55 x 0.5 m external; fallback 0.48 m high with a 12 mm lining, D-16) fits in at least two team members' cars (back seat or hatch), measured with the box dimensions and recorded before P6/P9 are frozen
nodes.note: P9/P25; owner D7; method D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Build processes
nodes.text: Every part in every parts.csv is bought or made by one of: hot-wire XPS from printed templates, packing-tape skin, knife- or laser-cut foam board, FDM PETG or PLA, epoxy or CA bonds, standard fasteners, hand-cut CF tube; no composite lay-up, no machining beyond drilling; printed parts <= 0.2 m on any axis
nodes.note: P10; owner G1; method I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Milestones
nodes.text: Twin flown before the order; electronics and CF tubes ordered by about 2026-11-20, everything else by 2026-12-15; first XPS hover by build week 4; first transition by week 7; complete by 2027-04-30 with one crash-repair loop (>= 1.5 weeks calendar) and the 7-business-day RFS request lead inside the plan
nodes.note: P11; owner I2; method I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Crash repair
nodes.text: A crashed wing core is re-cut and skinned in <= 1 day from stock on hand (>= 1 spare XPS sheet, hot-wire templates and printed-part STLs kept in the repo); the BOM holds spares: 1 motor, 4 ESCs, 8 props, 1 CF tube, 4 feet
nodes.note: P12; owner G1; method I+D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Every part connected
nodes.text: Every part in every interfaces.json has at least one structural interface and, where it carries current or heat, an electrical or thermal one; interfaces/merge_check.py and fusion/check.py pass with zero floating parts and zero unacknowledged edges
nodes.note: P24/P4; owner A4; method A; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Joint stacks
nodes.text: Every fastened or bonded joint in the README joint table has a joint-stack entry: fastener size x length and grade or adhesive, hole or insert, thread engagement >= 1 x diameter in a heat-set insert (or >= 2.0 x in bare plastic), torque or 'snug + threadlocker', tool, access direction, install and removal order
nodes.note: P24; owner C6; method I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Proof chain builds
nodes.text: proofs/build_graph.py exits 0 with zero drift; every requirement in this set has >= 1 claim with a how-to-verify line before CDR; build_graph.py --strict passes (no negative margin, no unverified requirement) before the first flight
nodes.note: P24; owner J2; method A; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: FAA and university compliance
nodes.text: Take-off mass < 25 kg (covered by R-MASS-GATE); FAA registration done and the number displayed on the airframe; each pilot holds a TRUST certificate and AMA membership; aircraft and pilots registered with the UC Drone Program under a PI sponsor; the FAA UAS facility map for RFS checked once and the airspace class recorded
nodes.note: P20; owner H3; method I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Site rules and flight card
nodes.text: Flights only at RFS yellow sub-fields 1-4, within 06:00-sunset (flight card 07:00-10:00), <= 400 ft AGL, VLOS <= 500 m from the pilot, with a spotter, a request >= 7 business days ahead and a post-flight report within 3 business days; no Remote ID module while every flight is inside the FRIA (a conditional line stays in the BOM)
nodes.note: P20/P3; owner H3; method I+D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Battery handling
nodes.text: Packs are stored and carried at storage charge (3.80-3.85 V/cell) in a LiPo bag; charged attended on a non-flammable surface with sand or an extinguisher at hand, never in a car; inspected for puffing before every charge; bought from US stock and shipped by ground
nodes.note: P21; owner H3; method I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Pilot readiness
nodes.text: The designated pilot logs >= 10 h of ArduPilot SITL on the tailsitter model with the team's parameter file, including QSTABILIZE recovery from a failed transition, plus stick time on the foam-board twin or a small quad, before the first XPS hover
nodes.note: P22; owner H2; method I; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Foam-board twin gate
nodes.text: The foam-board twin on the real motors, FC and pack holds position within 1 m in calm air and in a 5 m/s fan or breeze with logged lean <= 20 deg; flies QLOITER at >= 30 m; completes a transition at >= 1.3 Vs, two laps and a back-transition; hover current within +/-0.15 x 27 A of that value and cruise near 20.7 A; the elevon size that gives clean FBWA authority is recorded. A wind fail triggers the K11 planform test, then the K01 fallback (CONFIGURATION.md)
nodes.note: P23; owner H2; method D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: Test gates in order
nodes.text: Gates passed and logged in order, none skipped: (1) twin (R-TWIN); (2) thrust stand, one station (R-HOVER-TW); (3) XPS aircraft weigh-in (R-MASS-GATE) and tethered hover with current within +/-0.15 x 27 A of that value and the limiter verified (R-ESC-CURRENT); (4) untethered QHOVER/QLOITER; (5) fixed-wing tune as a plain flying wing; (6) first transition at >= 50 m AGL with QSTABILIZE recovery rehearsed; (7) back-transition at altitude; (8) landing practice in calm air; (9) full mission (R-MISSION). H3 gives go/no-go on the 5 m/s flight card
nodes.note: P23; owner H2; method D; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md

nodes.title: RFS wind measured
nodes.text: RFS morning wind is measured with a handheld anemometer on >= 3 mornings at 2 m height against the RCMC1 real-time reading; the ratio RFS/RCMC1 is < 1.4 (else the K01 reversal in CONFIGURATION.md applies) and the flight-card limit is rescaled to the measured ratio
nodes.note: P25/P8; owner H3; method T; see team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md
